text: F03.2 complete; O03.6 is ready and remains the first recovery priority. Consume PolicySql.commit and docs/policy-transactions.md plus docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/F03.2/receipt.json. One exclusive policy guard/revision/history now covers current organization, exact grants/expiry/lineage, API credentials and offboarding invalidation. Retain old organization-local-v1 and new policy-local-v2 event identities/bytes; enrollment needs the complete current checkpoint including eligibility/lifecycle input columns, never defaulting away unsupported restrictions. New local events include command intent digest, machine reason, before/after changes, operator DB identity and explicit LocalOnly status; no bearer secrets. Implement the ADR004 signed wire protocol, bounded PREPARE before catalog commit, COMMIT/ABORT/pending-outcome resolution, startup/epoch fencing and verified independent acknowledgment here, not via a second history/outbox. Local credential issuance has no caller-supplied retry key; preserve internal event identity and resolve ambiguous issuance. Public identity/lifecycle administration remains F04/O04; no organization-aware restore until O03.7/O03.8 qualification.
